verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime publishes endpoint-level API reference pages, such as Create a Webhook and List Webhooks, and a first-party Postman Collection that is runnable against a free Developer Sandbox for exploring the APIs. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an in-browser 'try it' console in the API reference, documented runnable code examples embedded in reference pages, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: you can do your testing as in command line or using our Postman Collection to speed up your initial exploration of our APIs.
safely test the API without worrying about interfering with production data.
